{"consolidated_memory":"**Lock Timeout Issue in storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql — Two Separate Occasions**

**OCCASION 1: [2026-01-23]**
- Problem: Lock timeout in migration 0042
- Reproduction: run the migration against a loaded table
- Signal: lock wait that trips the statement timeout
- Trigger: affected only clients pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: a listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #1454 on branch fix/lock-timeout-1
- Measured outcome: memory settled at 918 MB instead of climbing past 1 GB
- CI coverage: migration dry run

**OCCASION 2: [2026-04-24]**
- Problem: Lock timeout in migration 0042
- Reproduction: run the migration against a loaded table
- Signal: lock wait that trips the statement timeout
- Trigger: affected only payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: a mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #3885 on branch fix/lock-timeout-2
- Measured outcome: throughput rose 80 percent, to 23 requests per second
- CI coverage: migration dry run

Stack: SQL in both cases. Two separate defects in the same migration file with different triggering conditions and distinct solutions."}
